pick.name: Apollo.io
pick.what: B2B contact database, enrichment, email, sequences, MCP connector
pick.why: Data + engagement in one tool with a free plan; exact prices not shown on the public page
pick.free_limits: Free and Starter plans exist; credits pooled monthly, reset each cycle; free plan connects Gmail only

best_free.name: Clay (Free)
best_free.what: Waterfall enrichment and AI research tables
best_free.why: Best for combining many data providers; Free: 500 actions + 100 data credits/mo, 200 rows/table
best_free.free_limits: Free: 500 actions/mo, 100 data credits/mo; Launch from about USD 167-185/mo

alts.name: ZoomInfo
alts.why: Deepest data for US enterprise; quote-only pricing, credit-based exports
alts.free_limits: Free trial for some plans; no public prices

alts.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator Core
alts.what: Advanced lead search and account mapping
alts.why: Best for named-account buying-committee mapping; USD 119.99/mo (earlier pass)

candidates.name: Apollo
candidates.verdict: PICK: best value across data + engagement

candidates.name: NPPES NPI Registry
candidates.verdict: Free US public data to build healthcare lists (API status unverified)

decision: Apollo wins on breadth and price for a small team; Clay wins when match rates need many providers; ZoomInfo only when budget and US enterprise coverage justify a contract. Verify emails before sending and respect local consent rules.
details: Merged B2B lead sources slot. Apollo re-judged on merit; plan limits come from the public page, which omits prices.

region_notes.EU: Prospecting EU contacts needs a lawful basis (legitimate interest) and opt-out under GDPR/ePrivacy.
region_notes.UK: PECR allows B2B email to corporate addresses with opt-out; individual sole traders need consent.
region_notes.India: DPDP applies to personal data from 13 May 2027.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
